These unchanged PowerPoint 97–2003 samples come from Apache POI's
[slideshow test data](https://github.com/apache/poi/tree/6327f056ba3cfdae326a0261a236460592b80f5c/test-data/slideshow)
at commit `6327f056ba3cfdae326a0261a236460592b80f5c`:

- `basic_test_ppt_file.ppt`: two slides, speaker notes, and incremental edits.
- `incorrect_slide_order.ppt`: slide order differs from object/storage order.
- `54880_chinese.ppt`: CJK, mixed-width text, and supplementary Unicode characters.
- `Password_Protected-hello.ppt`: encrypted input used only to verify rejection.
